emails.subject: Virtuoso crashing on netlist import - full log attached
emails.body:
Hi team,

We're seeing a consistent SIGSEGV in Virtuoso 23.1.1 whenever we attempt to import the attached netlist. The crash is reproducible and is blocking our tape-out scheduled for Friday.

Stacktrace excerpt:

  #0 0x00007f8a2c3d1234 in VirtuosoCore::NetlistParser::parseNode
  #1 0x00007f8a2c3d5678 in VirtuosoCore::NetlistParser::parse
  #2 0x00007f8a2c3d9abc in VirtuosoCore::NetlistParser::importFile

We tried reverting to 22.1 and the import succeeds. This appears to be a regression.

Please treat this as critical, tape-out deadline is Friday 5pm IST.

Priya Sharma
Sr. Design Engineer, GlobalFab

On Thu, 4 Sep 2025 at 18:22, Cadence Support wrote: > Thanks for raising this. Could you confirm the exact build number? > We will need the full log to reproduce internally. > Regards, Support

emails.subject: Re: JasperGold property failing - need guidance on assertion syntax
emails.body:
Hi,

Following up on last week's thread. The assertion still fails intermittently. We narrowed it to the assume statement interaction with the clock gating cell.

Property in question:
assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (rst) req |-> ##[1:4] ack);
assume property (@(posedge clk) !gating_en);

Removing the assume resolves the spurious failure but that is not a real fix. Can someone from the JasperGold team review our constraint setup?

Alex Novak
Verification Lead

emails.subject: Verilog-A model review request - BSIM-BULK transistor model
emails.body:
Hi,

Attaching our Verilog-A implementation of the BSIM-BULK model. We are seeing a 12% mismatch in parameter extraction in the saturation region compared to the SPICE reference.

Suspect the issue is in our Vth0 calculation or the mobility degradation factor. Would appreciate a review of the model equations.

-- Michael Chen

emails.subject: Innovus timing violation - hold fix loop not converging
emails.body:
Hi,

Running ECO hold fix on a 5nm design. After 12 iterations Innovus is still reporting 847 hold violations (WNS -0.042ns). The tool appears to be looping, adding buffers in one domain creates violations in another.

Cmd used: setAnalysisMode -analysisType bcwc; optDesign -hold -outDir ./hold_fix

Log attached. Any known workaround for this convergence issue?

Debug Team
FabricLab
